title: Determinant-normalized Koszul conormal comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, $r\geq0$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_r$ generators of $I$. Put $B=A/I$, $C=I/I^2$, $N=\operatorname{Hom}_B(C,B)$ and $D=\bigwedge_B^rN$, using exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. Let $E=A^{\oplus r}$, let $c_f:E\to C$ send $e_i$ to the class of $f_i$, and let $L^\bullet$ be the total dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex]. Regard $D$ as an $A$-module by restriction of scalars. A morphism of cochain complexes $\phi:L^\bullet\to D[-r]$ is a determinant-normalized conormal comparison if, for every $x\in\operatorname{Hom}_A(K_r,A)$ and $v_1,\ldots,v_r\in E$, the determinant pairing satisfies $\langle\phi^r(x),c_f(v_1)\wedge\cdots\wedge c_f(v_r)\rangle=(-1)^{r(r-1)/2}\overline{x(v_1\wedge\cdots\wedge v_r)}\in B$. The pairing is the canonical map $\bigwedge_B^rN\to\operatorname{Hom}_B(\bigwedge_B^rC,B)$, with value on decomposable tensors equal to the determinant of their evaluations. The sign follows Stacks' ordered contraction convention: the composition $\delta_1\circ\cdots\circ\delta_r$ evaluates to $(-1)^{r(r-1)/2}$ on the ordered top wedge.
